summary.en: A free one-week programme that connects young technical builders with founders of billion-dollar companies, with an optional $10,000 investment. Open to high-school students, university students and dropouts anywhere in the world.
summary.ka: უფასო ერთკვირიანი პროგრამა, რომელიც ახალგაზრდა ტექნიკურ შემქმნელებს მილიარდიანი კომპანიების დამფუძნებლებთან აკავშირებს და სურვილისამებრ 10 000 დოლარის ინვესტიციას სთავაზობს. ღიაა სკოლის მოსწავლეების, სტუდენტებისა და სწავლამიტოვებულებისთვის მთელი მსოფლიოდან.
summary.ar: برنامج مجاني مدته أسبوع يربط المبتكرين التقنيين الشباب بمؤسسي شركات تبلغ قيمتها مليارات الدولارات، مع استثمار اختياري قدره 10,000 دولار. متاح لطلاب المدارس والجامعات ومن تركوا الدراسة من أي مكان في العالم.

about.en:
Z Fellows is a short, intense programme for early-stage technical builders. Each cohort spends one week, mostly online, meeting founders of very large technology companies, getting feedback on what they are building and joining a network that stays with them for the life of their company. The last day is held in person in San Francisco or New York.

There is no age limit and no need to have a registered company or to quit school or a job: past fellows include high-school students, undergraduates, dropouts, recent graduates and people in full-time work. You can apply alone or with co-founders (one application per team).

The programme is free. Fellows may also accept a $10,000 investment on a $1B valuation cap, which converts into stock at the next priced round, so it costs almost nothing in equity. It is one of the lightest-touch ways for a young builder to get access to top Silicon Valley founders.

en: Free one-week programme, mostly virtual, final day in San Francisco or New York
Optional $10,000 investment at a $1B valuation cap
No age limit; high-school and university students welcome

eligibility.en: Open worldwide to technical builders of any age, including high-school and university students and dropouts. You do not need a company yet. Teams submit one application. Programme language is English.

en: Go to zfellows.com and click 'Apply Now'
Describe what you are building and your technical background; list co-founders in the same form
Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis; shortlisted applicants are interviewed
Rejected applicants may reapply later

costs.en: Free to take part. Optional $10,000 investment (converts at a $1B cap). Travel to the in-person final day may be at your own cost; check with the organisers.

score_reason: Free, worldwide, rolling and genuinely open to teenagers

deadline_note: rolling — no deadline published; apply any time

summary.en: Fast, low-paperwork grants and fellowships run by economist Tyler Cowen for people anywhere in the world with ambitious, scalable ideas. Applicants can be as young as 13.
summary.ka: ეკონომისტ ტაილერ კოუენის მიერ მართული სწრაფი და მარტივი გრანტები ადამიანებისთვის მთელი მსოფლიოდან, ვისაც ამბიციური, მასშტაბირებადი იდეები აქვს. განაცხადის შეტანა 13 წლიდან შეიძლება.
summary.ar: منح وزمالات سريعة وقليلة الإجراءات يديرها الاقتصادي تايلر كوين لأصحاب الأفكار الطموحة القابلة للتوسع من أي مكان في العالم. يمكن التقديم من عمر 13 عامًا.

about.en:
Emergent Ventures (EV) is a fellowship and grant programme at the Mercatus Center at George Mason University, led by economist Tyler Cowen. It backs individuals with 'zero to one' ideas that could improve society: a startup, a research project, a piece of writing, a non-profit, or simply time and travel to develop a talent. Many winners are teenagers and university students.

Besides the general programme, EV has dedicated tranches for Africa and the Caribbean, India, Ukraine, UK dynamism, archaeology, US science policy and travel for career development. Grants are decided quickly with very little bureaucracy, and recipients join a strong global network of past winners.

The application is a short online form. Applications written with AI are rejected (AI may only be used for proofreading), so write it yourself and be specific about what you will do with the money.

en: Open worldwide from age 13
Any field: startups, research, writing, non-profits, talent development
Special tranches for Africa, India, Ukraine and others

eligibility.en: Anyone aged 13 or older, from any country. One application per person and project. Applications must be written by the applicant; AI-written applications are rejected.

en: Read the programme page at mercatus.org/emergent-ventures
Open the application form (mercatus.tfaforms.net/5099527)
Explain your project, what you will use the grant for and why it matters
Submit once; the team cannot give feedback or status updates

costs.en: Free to apply. Grant size depends on the project and is not published.

score_reason: Rolling worldwide grants from age 13 with minimal paperwork

deadline_note: rolling — no deadline; replies within about two weeks

summary.en: No-strings micro-grants of at least $1,000 from the 1517 Fund for high-school students, university students and dropouts working on their own projects. Funding is limited to teams in North America.
summary.ka: 1517 Fund-ის უპირობო მიკროგრანტები (მინიმუმ 1000 დოლარი) სკოლის მოსწავლეებისთვის, სტუდენტებისა და სწავლამიტოვებულებისთვის, რომლებიც საკუთარ პროექტებზე მუშაობენ. დაფინანსება მხოლოდ ჩრდილოეთ ამერიკის გუნდებისთვისაა.
summary.ar: منح صغيرة بلا شروط لا تقل عن 1,000 دولار من صندوق 1517 لطلاب المدارس والجامعات ومن تركوا الدراسة ممن يعملون على مشاريعهم الخاصة. التمويل مقتصر على الفرق في أمريكا الشمالية.

about.en:
The Medici Project is the grant arm of the 1517 Fund, a venture firm that backs dropouts, students and deep-tech scientists. It gives a minimum $1,000 stipend, with no equity or IP taken, to young people building something in any field: science, technology, maths or the arts. It is not a prize for past work but a bet on what you will do next, and the project must not be for school grades or admissions.

Applying is informal: you send a five-minute video about who you are, why the project matters to you and how the money would help. Grants are paid quickly. Recipients often stay in touch with the 1517 community, which also invests in startups founded by young people.

Note: because of international regulations, grants are restricted to teams in North America; others may write in, but support may be limited.

en: At least $1,000, no strings and no equity taken
Any field, including science and the arts
Simple video application, answer within about two weeks

eligibility.en: High-school students, university students and dropouts. Grants are limited to teams based in North America; applicants elsewhere can contact the team but direct funding may not be possible.

en: Record a five-minute Loom video: who you are, your project, how the grant would help
Email it to a 1517 team member (firstname@1517fund.com) or use the 'Get in Touch' form on 1517fund.com
Wait for a reply (about two weeks for in-thesis submissions)

costs.en: Free to apply. Grant of at least $1,000, paid directly.

score_reason: Easy, rolling, but North America only

duration.en: Cohort-based residency, typically several weeks to months

duration.ar: إقامة ضمن دفعات، عادةً من عدة أسابيع إلى أشهر

summary.en: Antler is a global early-stage investor that helps individuals find co-founders, build a company from scratch and raise pre-seed funding in more than 25 cities. You can apply alone, with just an idea, or with a team.
summary.ka: Antler გლობალური ადრეული ეტაპის ინვესტორია, რომელიც 25-ზე მეტ ქალაქში ეხმარება ადამიანებს თანადამფუძნებლის პოვნაში, კომპანიის ნულიდან შექმნასა და პრე-სიდ დაფინანსების მოზიდვაში. შეგიძლიათ მიმართოთ მარტომ, მხოლოდ იდეით, ან გუნდით.
summary.ar: Antler مستثمر عالمي في المراحل المبكرة يساعد الأفراد على إيجاد شركاء مؤسسين وبناء شركة من الصفر والحصول على تمويل ما قبل البذرة في أكثر من 25 مدينة. يمكنك التقديم بمفردك أو بفكرة فقط أو مع فريق.

about.en:
Antler runs founder residencies in cities across Asia-Pacific (Singapore, Tokyo, Seoul, Bangalore, Jakarta, Kuala Lumpur, Ho Chi Minh City, Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane), the Americas (San Francisco, New York, Austin, Toronto, São Paulo), Europe (London, Amsterdam/Berlin, Copenhagen, Stockholm, Oslo, Helsinki), the Middle East (Dubai, Riyadh) and Africa (Lagos, Nairobi). Founders join a cohort, test ideas, meet potential co-founders and pitch Antler's investment committee for pre-seed capital.

Upcoming cohort start dates published on Antler's site: Tokyo 2 November 2026; Brisbane, Sydney and Melbourne 8 February 2027; Lagos and Seoul 15 March 2027; Nairobi 22 March 2027. Toronto, San Francisco, Austin, New York and the Nordic cities take founders on a rolling basis. These are start dates, not deadlines, so apply early.

It suits recent graduates and young professionals who want to start a company but do not yet have a co-founder. Investment terms vary by location and are explained during the process.

en: Programmes in 25+ cities on five continents
Apply solo or as a team, even at idea stage
Pre-seed investment for teams that pass investment committee

eligibility.en: Aspiring founders (usually 18+ with work or technical experience); you can apply as an individual without a co-founder or idea. Each location sets its own requirements (right to work, residence). Language: English.

en: Go to antler.co/apply
Fill in your details and choose your stage (Idea to Pre-Seed), region and city
Check cohort start dates on antler.co/cohort-start-dates
If shortlisted, complete interviews with the local team

costs.en: No fee to join. Antler invests in companies in exchange for equity; terms differ by city. Living costs during the residency are usually your own.

score_reason: Global, rolling and solo founders welcome; better for graduates than school students

summary.en: A remote-first, three-month Techstars accelerator for technical founders, with three in-person offsites and a Demo Day on 3 June 2027. Applications close on 18 November 2026.
summary.ka: Techstars-ის სამთვიანი, ძირითადად დისტანციური აქსელერატორი ტექნიკური დამფუძნებლებისთვის, სამი პირისპირ შეხვედრით და Demo Day-ით 2027 წლის 3 ივნისს. განაცხადების მიღება 2026 წლის 18 ნოემბერს სრულდება.
summary.ar: مسرّعة من Techstars مدتها ثلاثة أشهر تُدار عن بُعد بالأساس للمؤسسين التقنيين، مع ثلاث لقاءات حضورية ويوم عرض في 3 يونيو 2027. يُغلق التقديم في 18 نوفمبر 2026.

about.en:
Techstars is one of the world's best-known accelerator networks. Techstars Anywhere is its remote-first programme: founders keep working from home, take part online in mentorship, workshops and investor preparation, and travel to three in-person offsites in startup hubs. The programme starts on 8 March 2027 and ends with Demo Day on 3 June 2027.

The 2027 cohort looks for domain experts building valuable technology across industries, with a particular emphasis on robotics, energy, applied and physical AI and materials science. It is designed for companies working in North American time zones, but there is no relocation requirement.

Selected companies receive Techstars investment (terms are given on the application portal), lifetime access to the Techstars network of mentors, alumni and investors, and perks worth large sums in software credits. It suits student or graduate founders who already have a product or prototype.

en: Remote-first, no relocation, three in-person offsites
Focus on robotics, energy, applied AI and materials
Demo Day 3 June 2027 in front of investors

eligibility.en: Startup founders with a product or strong technical prototype, any nationality; the programme runs on North American time zones. Apply as a company team.

en: Read the programme page at techstars.com/accelerators/anywhere
Create an account at apply.techstars.com and choose Techstars Anywhere
Submit the application (team, product, traction, video) by 18 November 2026
Shortlisted teams interview with the managing director

costs.en: No fee. Techstars invests in each company in exchange for equity (see the application portal for current terms). Offsite travel may be at the company's expense.

score_reason: Top accelerator, remote, deadline soon; needs an existing startup

duration.ka: შერჩევა 2026 ნოემბერი – 2027 აპრილი; ფინალი 2027 წლის 2–3 ივნისი
duration.ar: الاختيار من نوفمبر 2026 إلى أبريل 2027؛ النهائيات 2–3 يونيو 2027

summary.en: The world's leading deep-tech startup competition, with 13 tracks from climate to biotech, a €200,000 equity prize and finals at the Hello Tomorrow Summit in Amsterdam. Applications close on 30 November 2026.
summary.ka: მსოფლიოს წამყვანი დიპ-ტექ სტარტაპების კონკურსი 13 მიმართულებით, კლიმატიდან ბიოტექნოლოგიებამდე, 200 000 ევროს წილობრივი პრიზით და ფინალით ამსტერდამში, Hello Tomorrow Summit-ზე. განაცხადები 2026 წლის 30 ნოემბრამდე მიიღება.
summary.ar: أبرز مسابقة عالمية لشركات التكنولوجيا العميقة الناشئة، بـ13 مسارًا من المناخ إلى التقنية الحيوية، وجائزة استثمارية بقيمة 200,000 يورو، ونهائيات في قمة Hello Tomorrow في أمستردام. يُغلق التقديم في 30 نوفمبر 2026.

about.en:
The Hello Tomorrow Global Challenge, now in its 12th edition, selects the most promising science-based startups in the world. There are twelve industry tracks (computing and cybersecurity, aerospace, mobility, climate tech, digital health and medtech, energy, agri-food, industrial AI and robotics, industrial biotech, new materials and green chemistry, medical biotech and pharma, semiconductors) plus a cross-cutting 'Spinout Breakthroughs' track for university spin-outs.

Timeline: applications 23 September to 30 November 2026; 'Deep Tech Pioneers' selected in February 2027; finalists announced in April 2027; Investor Day with 350+ investors on 1 June 2027 and the Summit and Challenge Finals on 2–3 June 2027 in Amsterdam. Selected Pioneers get exposure to investors, corporates and media; the top prize is a €200,000 equity investment from DeepBright Ventures, and there is a dedicated prize for idea and pre-seed teams.

Ideal for student and PhD researchers turning lab work into a company.

en: €200,000 equity prize plus an early-stage prize
13 tracks covering all major deep-tech fields
Finals in Amsterdam before 350+ investors

eligibility.en: Startups from early development up to Series B built on a new technology, scientific discovery or complex engineering; at least two team members; not a subsidiary of an existing company. Open to all nationalities.

en: Read the rules at hello-tomorrow.org/global-challenge
Choose the track that fits your technology
Submit the online application by 30 November 2026
Optional: join the 'Ask Me Anything' info sessions
Pioneers are announced in February 2027, finalists in April 2027

costs.en: Free to apply. Finalists' attendance at the Summit is supported by the organisers; check the rules for travel coverage.

score_reason: Prestigious, free, worldwide, deadline in a month

deadline_note: rolling — sign up any time

summary.en: Microsoft's free programme for startups, giving up to $150,000 in Azure credits plus AI models, developer tools and technical resources. Founders sign up online at any time.
summary.ka: Microsoft-ის უფასო პროგრამა სტარტაპებისთვის: 150 000 დოლარამდე Azure კრედიტი, ხელოვნური ინტელექტის მოდელები, დეველოპერის ინსტრუმენტები და ტექნიკური რესურსები. რეგისტრაცია ონლაინ ნებისმიერ დროს შეიძლება.
summary.ar: برنامج مجاني من Microsoft للشركات الناشئة يمنح أرصدة Azure تصل إلى 150,000 دولار، إلى جانب نماذج ذكاء اصطناعي وأدوات تطوير وموارد تقنية. يمكن للمؤسسين التسجيل عبر الإنترنت في أي وقت.

about.en:
Microsoft for Startups (formerly the Founders Hub) is a self-serve programme that helps early-stage companies build on Microsoft's cloud. Members can receive up to $150,000 in credits for eligible Azure services, access to leading AI models and tools, technical documentation and guidance, and free access to selected software and platforms. Credits can be used from early development all the way to production workloads.

There is no cohort and no deadline: you sign up online, describe your startup and unlock benefits in stages as your company grows. It is particularly useful for student founders building AI or software products who need cloud computing without paying for it.

Credit levels and requirements change from time to time, so check the current terms on the official page when you register.

en: Up to $150,000 in Azure credits
Access to AI models, developer tools and technical guidance
Free, online and open year-round

eligibility.en: Early-stage startups and founders worldwide; requirements for each credit tier are shown during sign-up (a Microsoft account and a description of your product are needed). Must be 18+ to accept the terms.

en: Go to microsoft.com/startups and click 'Get started now'
Sign in with a Microsoft account and describe your startup
Accept the terms and activate your first tier of benefits
Unlock larger credit tiers as your startup progresses

costs.en: Free. No equity taken.

score_reason: Free, rolling, global and useful for any student founder

summary.en: Africa's leading award and fellowship for very young entrepreneurs aged 15 to 22 who already run a business or social venture. Applications for the 2027 intake close on 10 November 2026.
summary.ka: აფრიკის წამყვანი ჯილდო და სტიპენდია 15–22 წლის ახალგაზრდა მეწარმეებისთვის, რომლებსაც უკვე აქვთ მოქმედი ბიზნესი ან სოციალური პროექტი. 2027 წლის ნაკადზე განაცხადები 2026 წლის 10 ნოემბრამდე მიიღება.
summary.ar: أبرز جائزة وزمالة في أفريقيا لرواد الأعمال الصغار بين 15 و22 عامًا ممن يديرون بالفعل مشروعًا تجاريًا أو اجتماعيًا. يُغلق التقديم لدفعة 2027 في 10 نوفمبر 2026.

about.en:
The Anzisha Prize, run by the African Leadership Academy in partnership with the Mastercard Foundation, backs young African changemakers with funding, coaching and a platform. Since its launch it has supported 300+ fellows from more than 35 African countries and distributed over $2 million.

The 2027 intake is a multi-year fellowship designed to strengthen fellows' ventures, accelerate growth and create jobs. It is not for ideas: you must already have started your business, social project or invention and be able to show real activity such as customers, sales or beneficiaries. The business does not need to be registered and can be in any sector.

Application is free. It is one of the very few serious entrepreneurship awards designed specifically for teenagers.

en: For founders aged 15–22 only
Multi-year fellowship with funding and coaching
Free application; any sector, including social ventures

eligibility.en: Citizens of an African country (valid ID or passport), aged 15–22, who are founding members of a business operating in Africa and serving African customers or beneficiaries, with real activity (not just an idea).

en: Read the application guide on anzisha.org/apply
Prepare evidence of your venture's activity (customers, sales, beneficiaries)
Submit the free online application by 10 November 2026
Shortlisted applicants go through interviews and due diligence

costs.en: Free to apply. Fellowship support (funding, coaching, events) is provided by the programme.

score_reason: Rare youth-only founder award, fully free; Africa only, deadline very soon

deadline_note: call opens 3 Nov 2026 at 13:00 (GMT-3); closing date to be published with the call

summary.en: The Chilean government's equity-free accelerator, open to founders from any country, with 15 million CLP (Build) or 30 million CLP (Ignite) in funding. Applications for generation BIG 13 open on 3 November 2026.
summary.ka: ჩილეს მთავრობის აქსელერატორი, რომელიც წილს არ იღებს და ღიაა ნებისმიერი ქვეყნის დამფუძნებლებისთვის: 15 მილიონი ჩილეური პესო (Build) ან 30 მილიონი (Ignite). BIG 13 ნაკადზე განაცხადების მიღება 2026 წლის 3 ნოემბერს იწყება.
summary.ar: مسرّعة حكومية تشيلية لا تأخذ حصصًا من الشركات، ومفتوحة لمؤسسين من أي بلد، بتمويل 15 مليون بيزو تشيلي (Build) أو 30 مليونًا (Ignite). يبدأ التقديم لدفعة BIG 13 في 3 نوفمبر 2026.

about.en:
Start-Up Chile, run by Chile's economic development agency CORFO, is one of the world's best-known public accelerators. It gives equity-free funding: founders keep 100% of their company. Programmes: Build, a 4-month pre-acceleration for teams going from a validated idea to an MVP, with 15 million Chilean pesos; Ignite, a 4-month acceleration for startups with a working product and early validation that are under three years old, with 30 million pesos (plus a possible 20 million extension); and Growth for more mature companies. Industry and nationality do not matter, and teams led by women can receive up to 90% financing through the Female Founder Factor.

The BIG 13 generation call opens on 3 November 2026 at 13:00 Chile time. Selected startups usually base themselves in Chile during the programme and join a large international founder community in Santiago.

For students and young founders worldwide it is a rare chance to receive non-dilutive government funding and a Latin American launchpad.

en: Equity-free funding: 15M CLP (Build) or 30M CLP (Ignite)
Open to founders of any nationality and industry
Female Founder Factor: up to 90% financing for women-led teams

eligibility.en: Founders from any country. Build: validated idea to early prototype. Ignite: functional product with early validation, company under 3 years old. Check the legal bases for the BIG 13 call for residency and co-financing rules.

en: Read the Build, Ignite and Growth pages on startupchile.org
Wait for the BIG 13 call to open on 3 November 2026
Download the legal bases (bases legales) for your programme
Submit the online application with your team, product and pitch
Selected teams relocate to Chile for the programme

costs.en: No fee and no equity. Funding: 15M CLP (Build), 30M CLP (Ignite). Programmes usually require partial co-financing and living in Chile during the programme; see the legal bases.

score_reason: Equity-free, nationality-blind funding; call opens next week

about.en:
The Earth Prize, run by The Earth Foundation in Geneva, asks school students to design a solution to an environmental problem (waste, pollution, climate, biodiversity and more) at local, national or global scale. Since 2022 almost 21,000 students from 169 countries and territories have taken part.

2027 timeline: registration closes 10 January 2027; submissions close 31 January 2027; scholar selection in February and announcement on 3 March; a mentored scholar phase in March; regional winner phase in April; regional winners announced 9 May; public voting 10–23 May; awards ceremony 28 May 2027. Seven regional winners (Southeast Asia and Oceania, Asia, the Middle East, Africa, Europe, North America, Central and South America) each receive $10,000 to implement their idea, and mentors are also recognised.

Teams receive learning content and mentoring throughout. It is an excellent first 'startup-style' project for high-school students and looks strong on university applications.

en: $10,000 for each of seven regional winners
Free, online and open in 169+ countries
Mentoring and learning content for every team

eligibility.en: Students aged 13–19 enrolled in a secondary school anywhere in the world, usually in teams supported by a teacher mentor. Submissions in English.

en: Register your team at theearthprize.org/2027 before 10 January 2027
Find a teacher or adult mentor and choose an environmental problem
Develop your solution using the learning content
Submit your project by 31 January 2027

costs.en: Free to enter. Prizes: $10,000 per regional winner; $500 for Mentors of the Month.

about.en:
Falling Walls Lab is part of the Falling Walls Science Summit in Berlin, held around the anniversary of the fall of the Berlin Wall each November. Universities, embassies and research organisations host local Labs around the world. At each one, students and early-career professionals from all disciplines pitch 'which wall' their idea, research project or business could break, in exactly three minutes, to a jury of experts.

Winners of each local Lab (about 100 in total) advance to the Global Finale in Berlin, where they pitch again, meet scientists, investors and leaders, and attend the Falling Walls Science Summit. Many participants are master's or PhD students, but bachelor's students and young entrepreneurs also compete.

Applications for the 2027 season open on 1 February 2027. Each local Lab publishes its own date and deadline on the Falling Walls site, so look for one in your country or region.

en: Pitch any idea in three minutes, any discipline
~100 winners go to the Global Finale in Berlin
Network with scientists, investors and leaders at the Science Summit

eligibility.en: Bachelor's, master's and PhD students and early-career professionals; exact age and degree rules are in the applicant criteria on falling-walls.com. Pitches in English.

en: From 1 February 2027, find a local Lab near you on falling-walls.com/lab
Apply online with a short description of your idea before that Lab's deadline
If selected, pitch for three minutes at the local Lab
Local winners are invited to the Global Finale in Berlin in November

costs.en: Free to apply. Check the applicant FAQ for travel support for Berlin finalists.

score_reason: Prestigious, free pitch route to Berlin; 2027 applications open in February

about.en:
The Founder Institute (FI), founded in Silicon Valley, helps first-time founders go from idea to traction and first funding through a structured series of business-building sprints, weekly sessions with experienced founders and mentors, and peer accountability. You do not need a co-founder or to quit your job; many participants build part-time.

The fully virtual spring 2027 cohort runs from 17 March to 3 June 2027. FI also runs local chapters in dozens of countries (for example Abuja, Armenia, Bulgaria, Hungary, Croatia, Georgia, Czechia, Chile, Brazil and Australia), so you can choose a nearby city instead.

Graduates join FI's 'Equity Collective', in which founders, mentors and FI share in each other's success, and gain access to FI's investor network and alumni benefits. It suits university students and young professionals with an idea who want structure; it is paid, so compare it with free options first.

en: Fully online cohort, 17 Mar – 3 Jun 2027
Structured idea-to-funding methodology with mentors
Chapters in 100+ cities if you prefer local

eligibility.en: Aspiring founders worldwide, usually 18+; idea stage is fine and you can keep your job or studies. Applicants take an entrepreneur aptitude assessment. Programme language for the online cohort: English.

en: Go to fi.co/join and choose the 'Fully Virtual' cohort or a local chapter
Complete the application and the entrepreneur DNA assessment
Apply by 8 December 2026 for the early entrance fee
If accepted, pay the entrance fee and sign the programme agreement

costs.en: Entrance fee $1,099 (early, until 8 Dec 2026) or $1,599. Graduates contribute equity to the shared Equity Collective; see FI's programme agreements.

about.en:
The St. Gallen Symposium is one of the world's leading intergenerational forums, where senior leaders from business, politics and civil society debate with young 'Leaders of Tomorrow'. The 56th Symposium, on the theme 'Conditional Partnerships', takes place on 28–29 April 2027 at the University of St. Gallen.

The Global Ideas Competition is the main way in for students. The 2027 question is 'What could we solve, if we could agree?': identify a solvable problem that persists because parties cannot agree and propose a novel arrangement that would make solving it more effective. You submit a Solution Brief of up to 1,000 words (judged anonymously) and, if shortlisted, a video explainer of up to three minutes.

Three winners share CHF 20,000, and the top 100 entries become Leaders of Tomorrow with travel, accommodation in student flats and meals covered for the Symposium. Results are announced by mid-March 2027.

en: CHF 20,000 prize fund for three winners
Top 100 get an expenses-paid trip to the Symposium
Debate with CEOs, ministers and thought leaders

eligibility.en: Enrolled in a master's-level or higher programme at a research university (one that offers a PhD) on 1 February 2027, born in 1997 or later, any field, any nationality. Individual entries only; bachelor's students generally ineligible. English. Any AI use must be declared.

en: Read the rules on symposium.org/global-ideas-competition
Write a Solution Brief (max 1,000 words, four sections) answering the 2027 question
Submit online by 1 February 2027 (23:59 UTC-12)
If shortlisted, submit a video explainer of up to three minutes
Results by mid-March 2027; arrange your Swiss visa if invited

costs.en: Free to enter. Travel, accommodation and meals covered for the top 100; visa fees and pocket money (about CHF 100–200) at your own cost.

score_reason: Fully funded elite forum and cash prizes; graduate students only

summary.ar: أكبر مؤتمر دولي يديره طلاب هارفارد حول آسيا والشؤون العالمية، ويُعقد في حرم هارفارد في 5–7 فبراير 2027. يستمع مندوبون من عشرات الدول إلى قادة عالميين ويعملون في فرق على مشكلات واقعية.

about.en:
The Harvard College Project for Asian and International Relations (HPAIR), founded in 1991, has held 49 conferences in 34 countries and welcomed over 40,000 delegates. Past speakers include heads of state and government, the WHO Director-General and leading CEOs.

The 2027 Harvard Conference runs from 5 to 7 February 2027 on Harvard's campus. Delegates attend keynotes and panels on business, technology, policy, health and culture across Asia and the world, take part in 'impact challenges' solving real problems in small teams with mentors, and join networking events and an international talent night.

The application has two stages: an online form with a CV and short answers, then a video or Zoom interview. Early-bird applicants get a discounted ticket, earlier decisions (useful for US visas) and can apply for merit-based scholarships that cover part or all of travel and lodging.

en: Held on Harvard's campus, 5–7 Feb 2027
Speakers include world leaders and CEOs
Scholarships for early-bird applicants, including internationals

eligibility.en: Primarily university students (undergraduate and graduate) from any country; check the FAQ for age requirements. You will need a US visa or ESTA. English.

Apply in the early-bird round for the discount and scholarship eligibility
Complete the video or Zoom interview if invited
Register and pay the conference fee; arrange your US visa early

costs.en: Conference fee (discounted for early-bird) covers programming, lunches and the opening dinner. Travel and lodging are the delegate's own cost unless a scholarship is awarded.

about.en:
One Young World gathers about 2,000 young leaders from more than 190 countries each year, with counsellors such as former heads of state, Nobel laureates and business leaders. Delegates attend plenary sessions on climate, health, peace, education and business, give speeches from the main stage if selected as delegate speakers, and join an ambassador community that runs projects worldwide.

The 2026 Summit takes place in Cape Town in November 2026. The 2027 Summit will be held at the Tokyo International Forum, reportedly from 28 September to 1 October 2027. Delegates are usually sent by employers, universities or NGOs that pay the delegate fee, but many fully funded scholarships are offered by One Young World and partner companies. These open several months before the Summit.

Sign up on oneyoungworld.com to be told when 2027 delegate and scholarship applications open.

en: ~2,000 delegates from 190+ countries
Fully funded scholarships available each year
First summit in Asia since 2015, at the Tokyo International Forum

eligibility.en: Young leaders aged 18–35 of any nationality who are making an impact in their field. Scholarship criteria vary (some target specific countries, sectors or companies). English.

en: Watch oneyoungworld.com/apply for the 2027 delegate and scholarship calls
Ask your university, employer or NGO whether it sponsors delegates
Prepare a CV and short statement about your impact
Apply for a scholarship or as a self-funded/sponsored delegate

about.en:
The ECOSOC Youth Forum is the UN's flagship annual meeting of young people. It gives youth a platform to talk directly with Member States and other actors, voice their views and concerns and shape the agenda ahead of the High-Level Political Forum on the Sustainable Development Goals. Sessions include plenaries with ministers, regional breakouts and thematic discussions on the SDGs under review that year.

The 2027 Forum takes place at UN Headquarters in New York from 13 to 15 April 2027. Young people take part in three main ways: as members of their country's official youth delegation or as UN Youth Delegates; as representatives of youth organisations and NGOs that hold ECOSOC consultative status or are part of the Major Group for Children and Youth; and online, since sessions are usually webcast and open to virtual participation.

For a student this is the most direct way to see UN policy-making on youth issues up close. Contact your national youth council or the ministry responsible for youth early, as delegations are formed months in advance.

en: At UN Headquarters, New York, 13–15 April 2027
Direct dialogue with ministers and UN leaders
Join via a national delegation, an accredited NGO or online

eligibility.en: Young people (usually 18–29) from any UN Member State, nominated through national youth delegations, accredited youth organisations or the Major Group for Children and Youth. Virtual participation is generally open to all. You need your own US visa for in-person attendance.

en: Check the ECOSOC events page for the 2027 concept note and registration
Ask your national youth council or youth ministry about the official delegation
Or join through an NGO with ECOSOC consultative status / the UN Major Group for Children and Youth
Register via the UN's official registration (Indico) once it opens; apply for a US visa early

about.en:
The European Youth Event (EYE) takes place every two years at the European Parliament in Strasbourg. It brings together thousands of young people from across the EU and beyond to discuss Europe's present and future with MEPs, experts and activists through debates, workshops, hackathons, performances and creative sessions. Ideas collected at EYE are compiled into a report presented to MEPs.

EYE2027 will take place on 18–19 June 2027. The European Parliament has opened a call for active, engaged groups of young people (school classes, youth organisations, informal groups) to apply for a financial contribution toward travel and accommodation; the deadline is 13 November 2026. Groups that are not funded, and individuals, can usually register later when registration opens.

Groups from outside the EU have taken part in past editions; check the call's rules for which countries are eligible for the financial contribution.

en: Debate directly with Members of the European Parliament
Financial contribution available for selected youth groups
Thousands of participants, workshops, hackathons and culture

eligibility.en: Young people aged 16–30. The funding call is for groups (with a group leader aged 18+); check the call for country eligibility. Activities in many EU languages, mainly English.

en: Read the call for groups on european-youth-event.europarl.europa.eu
Form a group with a leader aged 18+
Submit the group application by 13 November 2026
If not funded, watch the site for open registration for EYE2027

costs.en: Participation free. Selected groups receive an EU financial contribution toward travel and accommodation; otherwise costs are your own.

summary.ka: საშუალო სკოლის კლასები ერთი დღით ევროპარლამენტის წევრები ხდებიან სტრასბურგში და მთელი ევროპის მოსწავლეებთან ერთად რეზოლუციებს განიხილავენ და კენჭს უყრიან. ღიაა ევროკავშირის წევრი, კანდიდატი და ყოფილი წევრი ქვეყნების სკოლებისთვის.
summary.ar: تصبح فصول المدارس الثانوية أعضاءً في البرلمان الأوروبي ليوم واحد في ستراسبورغ، حيث تناقش القرارات وتصوّت عليها مع طلاب من أنحاء أوروبا. متاح لمدارس الدول الأعضاء والدول المرشحة والدول الأعضاء السابقة.

about.en:
Euroscola, created by the European Parliament in 1990, has given hundreds of thousands of high-school students a day as MEPs in the Parliament's chamber in Strasbourg. Students aged at least 14 from the 27 EU member states, the EU candidate countries and former member states debate, take sides, negotiate, amend and vote on resolutions about real European issues, working in multilingual groups.

Sessions run throughout the school year (the next is on 10 November 2026). Schools take part as a class, accompanied by a teacher. Places are allocated through a national selection organised by the European Parliament Liaison Office in each country, often a competition; the Liaison Office also explains the travel-cost reimbursement for selected schools.

It is a free, memorable introduction to EU politics, and a great project for a motivated class and teacher.

en: A day as an MEP in the Strasbourg chamber
Open to EU, candidate and former member states
Travel costs reimbursed for selected schools

eligibility.en: Secondary-school students aged 14+, as a class with a teacher, from EU member states, EU candidate countries (for example Georgia, Moldova, Ukraine, Türkiye, Western Balkans) and former member states. Working languages vary; good English or French helps.

en: Ask your teacher to check the Euroscola 'How to participate' page
Contact the European Parliament Liaison Office for your country about the national selection
Take part in the national competition/selection
If selected, register the class for a session date and prepare on EU basics

costs.en: Free. Travel-cost reimbursement for selected schools is arranged via the Liaison Office.

score_reason: Free and year-round but needs a whole class and national selection

deadline_note: rolling — no fees, deadlines or cohorts

summary.en: NVIDIA's free programme for AI and deep-tech startups at any stage, offering technical resources, partner cloud credits, training and investor introductions. There are no fees, deadlines or cohorts.
summary.ka: NVIDIA-ს უფასო პროგრამა ნებისმიერ ეტაპზე მყოფი ხელოვნური ინტელექტისა და დიპ-ტექ სტარტაპებისთვის: ტექნიკური რესურსები, პარტნიორების ღრუბლოვანი კრედიტები, ტრენინგები და ინვესტორებთან გაცნობა. არ არის საფასური, ვადები და ნაკადები.
summary.ar: برنامج مجاني من NVIDIA لشركات الذكاء الاصطناعي والتكنولوجيا العميقة الناشئة في أي مرحلة، يوفر موارد تقنية وأرصدة سحابية من الشركاء وتدريبًا وتعارفًا مع المستثمرين. لا رسوم ولا مواعيد نهائية ولا دفعات.

about.en:
NVIDIA Inception supports startups building with AI, data science, graphics and other accelerated computing. Members get access to technical resources and NVIDIA experts, training through the NVIDIA Deep Learning Institute, preferred pricing and credits from NVIDIA and cloud partners, co-marketing (badges and social content) and, depending on eligibility, investor exposure through Inception Capital Connect and curated networking events with venture capital firms.

You can apply regardless of your funding stage: there are no application fees, deadlines or cohorts. Submit details about your company and product; NVIDIA reviews it and follows up, and more opportunities unlock as your engagement grows.

Very useful for student founders working on AI products who need GPUs, training and credibility with investors.

en: Free, no deadlines, any funding stage
Technical support, training and partner credits
Investor introductions via Inception Capital Connect

eligibility.en: Startups (a company with a website and product focus) working with AI or accelerated computing, at any funding stage, anywhere in the world.

en: Go to nvidia.com/startups and click 'Apply to Inception'
Submit details about your business and products
Keep your profile updated to receive offers and event invitations

costs.en: Free.

score_reason: Free and rolling; needs an existing AI startup

deadline_note: rolling — apply any time

summary.en: Amazon Web Services gives startups from pre-seed onwards up to $200,000 in cloud credits, with extra credits for AI startups. Apply any time for the tier that matches your stage.
summary.ka: Amazon Web Services პრე-სიდ ეტაპიდან დაწყებულ სტარტაპებს 200 000 დოლარამდე ღრუბლოვან კრედიტს აძლევს, ხოლო AI სტარტაპებს დამატებით კრედიტებს. ნებისმიერ დროს შეგიძლიათ მიმართოთ თქვენი ეტაპის შესაბამის საფეხურზე.
summary.ar: تمنح Amazon Web Services الشركات الناشئة بدءًا من مرحلة ما قبل البذرة أرصدة سحابية تصل إلى 200,000 دولار، مع أرصدة إضافية لشركات الذكاء الاصطناعي. قدّم في أي وقت على الفئة المناسبة لمرحلتك.

about.en:
AWS Activate is Amazon's programme for startups. It offers promotional AWS credits based on your funding stage, up to $200,000, plus additional credits for AI startups ready to scale, together with technical support, training and partner offers. Credits can be used for computing, storage, databases and AI services such as Amazon Bedrock.

Eligibility (as published): pre-Series B, founded in the last 10 years, an AWS account on a paid-tier plan, and being new to Activate credits or requesting a higher tier. Smaller self-funded tiers are open to very early founders, while larger tiers usually require backing from an accelerator, incubator or VC in the Activate network.

Useful for any student founder who needs to host a product without paying for cloud computing.

en: Up to $200,000 in AWS credits by stage
Extra credits for AI startups
Rolling, global, online application

eligibility.en: Startups worldwide that are pre-Series B, founded within the last 10 years, with an AWS paid-tier account; new to Activate or applying for a higher tier.

en: Create an AWS account on a paid-tier plan
Go to aws.amazon.com/startups/credits and pick your tier
Submit company details (website, stage, funding)
Credits are applied to your account if approved

costs.en: Free; credits expire after a set period.

score_reason: Free and rolling; useful once you have a product

deadline_note: rolling — apply any time

summary.en: Google Cloud's programme for pre-seed to Series A startups, with up to $350,000 in cloud credits over two years, Gemini model credits and a year of Google Workspace. Apply any time.
summary.ka: Google Cloud-ის პროგრამა პრე-სიდიდან Series A-მდე სტარტაპებისთვის: ორი წლის განმავლობაში 350 000 დოლარამდე ღრუბლოვანი კრედიტი, Gemini მოდელების კრედიტები და ერთი წლით Google Workspace. მიმართვა ნებისმიერ დროს შეიძლება.
summary.ar: برنامج Google Cloud للشركات الناشئة من مرحلة ما قبل البذرة حتى الجولة A، بأرصدة سحابية تصل إلى 350,000 دولار على مدى عامين، وأرصدة لنماذج Gemini، وسنة من Google Workspace. التقديم متاح في أي وقت.

about.en:
The Google for Startups Cloud Program supports digital-native startups that are new Google Cloud customers. At the prototyping stage you can get instant access to Google AI Studio to build an MVP. Pre-seed to Series A startups can apply for up to $350,000 in Google Cloud credits over two years, credits for frontier models such as Gemini and Gemma, technical and product training (Google Skills), 12 months of Google Workspace Business Plus and monthly Google Maps Platform credits. As you grow you can unlock dedicated help from Google's startup experts.

There is no deadline or cohort. It is a simple way for student founders to run AI products at no cost in their first years.

en: Up to $350,000 in Google Cloud credits over two years
Gemini/Gemma model credits and Workspace for a year
Rolling, online, worldwide

eligibility.en: Pre-seed to Series A startups founding digital-native products that are new Google Cloud customers; exact criteria are on the application page. Worldwide.

en: Go to cloud.google.com/startup
If you are just prototyping, start free in Google AI Studio
Otherwise click 'Apply to the program' and submit company details
Credits are issued if approved

costs.en: Free.

score_reason: Free and rolling; best for startups with a product

deadline_note: fixed annual week; events can be joined or registered on genglobal.org until the week ends

summary.en: A worldwide week of startup events, pitch nights, workshops and competitions on 16–22 November 2026, run by the Global Entrepreneurship Network with partners in around 200 countries. Students can join local events for free or host their own.
summary.ka: მსოფლიო მასშტაბის კვირა 2026 წლის 16–22 ნოემბერს: სტარტაპ-ღონისძიებები, პიჩ-საღამოები, ვორქშოპები და კონკურსები, რომელსაც Global Entrepreneurship Network დაახლოებით 200 ქვეყანაში პარტნიორებთან ერთად ატარებს. სტუდენტებს შეუძლიათ უფასოდ შეუერთდნენ ადგილობრივ ღონისძიებებს ან საკუთარი მოაწყონ.
summary.ar: أسبوع عالمي من فعاليات الشركات الناشئة وأمسيات العروض وورش العمل والمسابقات في 16–22 نوفمبر 2026، تنظمه شبكة ريادة الأعمال العالمية مع شركاء في نحو 200 دولة. يمكن للطلاب حضور الفعاليات المحلية مجانًا أو تنظيم فعالياتهم الخاصة.

about.en:
Global Entrepreneurship Week (GEW) is the world's largest celebration of entrepreneurship. In 2025 it involved about 200 countries, 20,000 partner organisations, 40,000 activities and 10 million people. Universities, incubators, governments, schools and companies run events during the week: startup weekends, pitch competitions, founder talks, mentoring sessions, hackathons and policy roundtables.

GEW 2026 runs from 16 to 22 November 2026. Students can use 'Find an Event' on the GEN website to locate activities near them or online, or use 'Add an Event' to register their own club or school event in the global calendar (with a promotional toolkit and logos). GEN's 'Ideas Bank' and 'Signature Activities' pages give ready-made formats.

It is a free, low-barrier first step into the startup world, and hosting an event is a good leadership project for a student club.

en: Free events in ~200 countries, online and in person
Find an event near you or host your own
Pitch nights, workshops, hackathons and founder talks

eligibility.en: Open to everyone; most events are free. Individual events may have their own age or registration rules.

en: Visit genglobal.org/gew
Use 'Find An Event' to pick local or online activities and register
Or click 'Add An Event' to list your own school or club event
Take part during 16–22 November 2026

costs.en: Free to participate; some partner events may charge.

score_reason: Free and accessible everywhere; a starting point rather than a programme

org: The Duke of Edinburgh's International Award Foundation

name.en: The Duke of Edinburgh's International Award

duration.ar: من 6 إلى 18 شهرًا لكل مستوى (برونزي، فضي، ذهبي)

deadline_note: rolling — start any time through an Award Centre (school, club or licensed organisation)

summary.en: A non-competitive youth award, available in more than 130 countries, in which 14–24-year-olds set personal goals in volunteering, physical activity, skills and an adventurous journey at Bronze, Silver and Gold levels.
summary.ka: არაკონკურსული ახალგაზრდული ჯილდო, რომელიც 130-ზე მეტ ქვეყანაშია ხელმისაწვდომი: 14–24 წლის ახალგაზრდები ისახავენ პირად მიზნებს მოხალისეობაში, ფიზიკურ აქტივობაში, უნარებსა და სათავგადასავლო ლაშქრობაში ბრინჯაოს, ვერცხლისა და ოქროს დონეებზე.
summary.ar: جائزة شبابية غير تنافسية متاحة في أكثر من 130 دولة، يضع فيها الشباب بين 14 و24 عامًا أهدافًا شخصية في التطوع والنشاط البدني والمهارات ورحلة استكشافية، على المستويات البرونزي والفضي والذهبي.

about.en:
The Duke of Edinburgh's International Award (known in many countries as the International Award for Young People) challenges young people to develop themselves through four sections: Voluntary Service, Physical Recreation, Skills and an Adventurous Journey, plus a Gold Residential Project at the top level. Participants choose their own activities and set goals with an adult Award Leader, then record progress in the Online Record Book.

Levels: Bronze (from age 14, at least 6 months, a 2-day/1-night journey); Silver (from 15, at least 12 months, or 6 if you hold Bronze, a 3-day/2-night journey); Gold (from 16, at least 18 months, or 12 if you hold Silver, a 4-day/3-night journey and a residential project). You must finish before your 25th birthday.

The Award is delivered in more than 130 countries, including Qatar, the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Türkiye, Ukraine, Moldova and most of Europe, through National Award Operators and licensed Independent Award Centres such as international schools and scout groups. It is widely recognised by universities and employers as evidence of commitment and character.

en: Recognised by universities and employers worldwide
Bronze, Silver and Gold levels from age 14
Available in 130+ countries via schools and licensed centres

eligibility.en: Young people aged 14–24 (Bronze from 14, Silver from 15, Gold from 16; complete before turning 25). You must register through an Award Centre (school, club or organisation) in your country.

en: Check 'Find the Award in your country' (intaward.org/do/regions-locations)
Ask your school or a listed Independent Award Centre to enrol you
Choose activities and goals for each section with your Award Leader
Log progress in the Online Record Book and complete your Adventurous Journey

costs.en: Participation fees are set by each country or Award Centre and are usually modest; expeditions may have equipment and travel costs.

score_reason: Rolling, global and valued by universities; requires a local Award Centre

summary.en: A summit at the United Nations in Geneva, also streamed online, that celebrates young activists changing their communities. The 2026 edition is on 17 December 2026; registration to attend opens soon.
summary.ka: სამიტი გაეროს ჟენევის ოფისში, რომელიც ონლაინაც გადაიცემა და საკუთარ თემებს შემცვლელ ახალგაზრდა აქტივისტებს ეძღვნება. 2026 წლის სამიტი 17 დეკემბერს გაიმართება; დასწრებაზე რეგისტრაცია მალე გაიხსნება.
summary.ar: قمة في مقر الأمم المتحدة في جنيف، تُبث أيضًا عبر الإنترنت، تحتفي بالناشطين الشباب الذين يغيّرون مجتمعاتهم. تُعقد نسخة 2026 في 17 ديسمبر 2026، ويُفتح التسجيل للحضور قريبًا.

about.en:
The Young Activists Summit (YAS) is held each year at the Palais des Nations in Geneva. It shines a light on young activists from around the world who are tackling issues such as climate, education, gender equality, health and human rights. Selected activists present their work in short talks and films, and the audience joins discussions with them and with UN and NGO representatives.

The 2026 Summit takes place on 17 December 2026 from 10:00 to 12:00 Geneva time, at the UN in Geneva and online. Registration to attend will open soon; subscribe to the newsletter on the official site to be notified.

It is a free, inspiring event for students interested in activism and international organisations; attending online is open to anyone.

en: Held at the United Nations in Geneva
Free to attend in person or online
Showcases young activists from around the world

eligibility.en: Open to the public, especially young people; in-person places are limited and require registration (UN security rules apply). Online viewing is open to all. English.

en: Visit youngactivistssummit.org and subscribe for registration news
Register to attend in Geneva or online once registration opens
Bring ID accepted by UN Geneva security if attending in person

costs.en: Free. Travel to Geneva at your own cost.

score_reason: Free UN event, short format; registration not yet open

summary.en: Two days of climate leadership training with former US Vice President Al Gore and leading experts in Budapest in February 2027, after which you join a global network of climate leaders. Applications open soon.
summary.ka: ორდღიანი კლიმატური ლიდერობის ტრენინგი აშშ-ის ყოფილ ვიცე-პრეზიდენტ ალ გორთან და წამყვან ექსპერტებთან ერთად ბუდაპეშტში 2027 წლის თებერვალში; ამის შემდეგ კლიმატის ლიდერთა გლობალურ ქსელს უერთდებით. განაცხადების მიღება მალე დაიწყება.
summary.ar: تدريب لمدة يومين على القيادة المناخية مع نائب الرئيس الأمريكي السابق آل غور وكبار الخبراء في بودابست في فبراير 2027، تنضم بعده إلى شبكة عالمية من قادة المناخ. يُفتح التقديم قريبًا.

about.en:
The Climate Reality Project, founded by Al Gore, runs Leadership Corps trainings around the world. Over two immersive days, participants learn the science of the climate crisis and its solutions, how to communicate it persuasively, and how to organise for change, with sessions led by Al Gore and world-class scientists, policy experts and activists.

After the training you become a Climate Reality Leader and join a global network with virtual and in-person community events, online courses and resources. Leaders are expected to take action afterwards, such as giving presentations, organising in their community or engaging decision-makers.

The next listed in-person training is in Budapest, Hungary, in February 2027. The application is not live yet; sign up on the training page to be told when it opens. Other online and in-person trainings are held during the year.

en: Training led by Al Gore and top climate experts
Join a global network of Climate Reality Leaders
Historically free to attend (travel your own)

eligibility.en: Adults (normally 18+) of any nationality with a commitment to climate action. English (with interpretation at some trainings). Selection by application.

en: Go to climaterealityproject.org/training
Sign up to be notified when the Budapest application goes live
Complete the application describing your climate commitment
If accepted, register and arrange travel to Budapest

costs.en: Training has historically been free of charge; travel, accommodation and visas are at your own cost. Check the application page for current terms.

score_reason: Prestigious climate training, application opening soon

org: World Economic Forum — Global Shapers Community

summary.en: The World Economic Forum's network of more than 11,000 young people under 30, organised in 450 city hubs in 140 countries, who run local projects on global problems.
summary.ka: მსოფლიო ეკონომიკური ფორუმის ქსელი, რომელიც 30 წლამდე ასაკის 11 000-ზე მეტ ახალგაზრდას აერთიანებს 140 ქვეყნის 450 ქალაქის ჰაბში; ისინი გლობალურ პრობლემებზე ადგილობრივ პროექტებს ახორციელებენ.
summary.ar: شبكة المنتدى الاقتصادي العالمي التي تضم أكثر من 11,000 شاب دون الثلاثين، منظمين في 450 مركزًا مدنيًا في 140 دولة، ينفذون مشاريع محلية لمعالجة مشكلات عالمية.

about.en:
The Global Shapers Community was created by the World Economic Forum for young people driving change in their cities. Shapers are organised in city-based hubs; each hub chooses its own projects (climate, education, civic engagement, mental health, inclusion and more) and runs them as volunteers. Selected Shapers are invited to WEF events such as the Annual Meeting in Davos and the Shaping Davos programme, and the network gives access to peers and leaders worldwide.

Membership is for people under 30 who have shown leadership and commitment to their community. Recruitment is done locally: each hub opens applications on its own schedule, typically once or twice a year, with an application form and interviews. Hubs exist in many capitals and large cities (for example Tbilisi and Doha).

Find your nearest hub on the official site and follow it on social media to catch the next recruitment round.

en: 11,000+ members in 450 hubs and 140 countries
Run local impact projects with peers
Chance to join World Economic Forum events

eligibility.en: Young people under 30 (most hubs recruit roughly 18–27) living in or near a hub's city, with demonstrated leadership and community impact. English plus local language.

en: Open globalshapers.org/hubs and find the hub in your city
Follow the hub's channels for its next recruitment call
Submit the hub's application (motivation, CV, project ideas)
Attend an interview with current Shapers

costs.en: Free membership; members volunteer their time.

score_reason: Prestigious global network; entry depends on local hub calls

summary.en: An Erasmus+ action that gives 18-year-olds a free travel pass, mainly by rail, to explore Europe for up to a month. The spring 2027 round is for people born between 1 July 2008 and 30 June 2009.
summary.ka: Erasmus+-ის ინიციატივა, რომელიც 18 წლის ახალგაზრდებს უფასო სამგზავრო საშვს აძლევს, ძირითადად მატარებლით, ევროპის ერთ თვემდე ვადით მოსამოგზაუროდ. 2027 წლის გაზაფხულის რაუნდი 2008 წლის 1 ივლისიდან 2009 წლის 30 ივნისამდე დაბადებულთათვისაა.
summary.ar: مبادرة من Erasmus+ تمنح الشباب في سن 18 تذكرة سفر مجانية، بالقطار أساسًا، لاستكشاف أوروبا لمدة تصل إلى شهر. جولة ربيع 2027 مخصصة للمولودين بين 1 يوليو 2008 و30 يونيو 2009.

about.en:
DiscoverEU lets young Europeans discover the continent's diversity, cultural heritage and history and meet people from all over Europe. Selected travellers receive a travel pass (mostly rail, with alternatives for islands and remote areas) to travel for up to 30 days, alone or in a group of up to five, plus a European Youth Card with discounts on culture, accommodation and food. summary.ka: Andreessen Horowitz-ის სტარტაპ აქსელერატორი, რომელიც ადრეული ეტაპის გუნდებში 1 მილიონ დოლარამდე ინვესტიციას დებს ორ კვირაში და 10 მილიონ დოლარზე მეტ პარტნიორულ კრედიტს გასცემს. SR008-ის ფანჯარა 2026 წლის 1 ნოემბერს იხურება, შემდგომი განაცხადები კი მომდევნო რეზიდენციაზე განიხილება.
summary.ar: مسرّعة الشركات الناشئة من Andreessen Horowitz، تستثمر حتى مليون دولار في الفرق في مراحلها الأولى خلال أسبوعين، مع أرصدة شركاء تتجاوز 10 ملايين دولار. تُغلق نافذة SR008 في 1 نوفمبر 2026، وتُحال الطلبات اللاحقة إلى الدورة التالية.

about.en:
speedrun is the accelerator of Andreessen Horowitz, one of the world's largest venture firms. Selected teams receive a first check of up to $1 million (with a target two-week close), more than $10 million in credits from 200+ partners, and help with customers and hiring. The residency runs in person at a16z's San Francisco office for sessions, office hours and events, and founders are expected to build full-time. Solo founders can apply; traction is not required, though early signs that people want the product help.

Applications for the SR008 residency were open 12 October – 1 November 2026. If you miss the window, you can still apply and your application is reviewed for the next residency.

For students, recent graduates and dropouts still finding their idea, a16z runs a separate 'alpha fellowship' (up to $250K, US work authorisation required); its current cycle closed on 11 October.

en: Up to $1M investment with a two-week close
$10M+ in partner credits
In-person residency in San Francisco; solo founders welcome

eligibility.en: Founders building full-time with an idea, early product and team (solo founders allowed), any sector, any nationality; must be able to attend in San Francisco.

en: Read the FAQ at speedrun.a16z.com/faq
Apply at speedrun.a16z.com/apply with team bios and deck
Applications after 1 Nov 2026 are reviewed for the next residency
Shortlisted teams interview with an investing partner

costs.en: No fee. a16z invests in exchange for equity. Living and travel costs are the founders'.

score_reason: Huge checks, rolling; for serious full-time founders

summary.en: SXSW's 19th annual startup pitch competition in Austin, Texas, where finalists across technology categories pitch to experts, early adopters and investors. Applications close on 13 November 2026 (entry fee $225).
summary.ka: SXSW-ის მე-19 ყოველწლიური სტარტაპების პიჩ-კონკურსი ოსტინში, ტეხასი, სადაც ფინალისტები ტექნოლოგიურ კატეგორიებში ექსპერტებს, ადრეულ მომხმარებლებსა და ინვესტორებს წარუდგენენ პროექტებს. განაცხადები 2026 წლის 13 ნოემბრამდე მიიღება (საფასური 225 დოლარი).
summary.ar: النسخة التاسعة عشرة من مسابقة عروض الشركات الناشئة في مهرجان SXSW في أوستن، تكساس، حيث يقدّم المتأهلون في فئات تقنية متعددة مشاريعهم أمام خبراء ومستخدمين أوائل ومستثمرين. يُغلق التقديم في 13 نوفمبر 2026 (رسوم 225 دولارًا).

about.en:
SXSW Pitch is a flagship event of the South by Southwest festival in Austin. Through an open call, startups from around the world apply in one of several categories, for example Emerging & Frontier Technologies (robotics, AI hardware, semiconductors, quantum, space), Entertainment, Media, Sports & Digital Platforms, Smart Data/Security/FinTech, and Healthcare/AssistiveTech/BioTech. Finalists pitch live on stage at SXSW in March 2027 to a panel of industry experts, early adopters and investors, and winners are announced at an awards ceremony.

Applications for 2027 opened on 23 June 2026; regular entry runs 14 September to 13 November 2026 with a $225 fee (non-refundable even if not selected). Finalists gain huge visibility in the SXSW press and investor community.

Best for student founders who already have a product with technical differentiation and can travel to Austin.

en: 19th edition, global open call
Live pitch at SXSW in Austin before investors and media
Multiple technology categories

eligibility.en: Startups from any country with a working product or strong technology; categories have specific requirements (e.g. defensible IP for frontier tech). Finalists must attend SXSW in Austin. English.

en: Read the 2027 categories and rules on sxsw.com/pitch
Prepare your company description, video and deck
Apply and pay the $225 regular entry fee by 13 November 2026
Finalists are notified and pitch at SXSW in March 2027

costs.en: Application fee $225 (non-refundable). Travel and stay in Austin at your own cost; finalists receive event access (see rules).

score_reason: Visible pitch stage but paid entry and needs an existing startup

name.ar: Techstars Startup Weekend — فعالية ناشئة لمدة 54 ساعة

deadline_note: rolling — hundreds of events a year; each local event sets its own date and registration

summary.en: A three-day event, held in more than 150 countries, where aspiring founders pitch ideas on Friday, form teams and build a startup prototype by Sunday's demo in front of judges.
summary.ka: სამდღიანი ღონისძიება 150-ზე მეტ ქვეყანაში: დამწყები დამფუძნებლები პარასკევს იდეებს წარადგენენ, გუნდებს ქმნიან და კვირამდე სტარტაპის პროტოტიპს აწყობენ, რომელსაც ჟიურის წინაშე აჩვენებენ.
summary.ar: فعالية لمدة ثلاثة أيام في أكثر من 150 دولة، يعرض فيها رواد الأعمال الطموحون أفكارهم يوم الجمعة، ويشكلون فرقًا، ويبنون نموذجًا أوليًا لشركة ناشئة يعرضونه أمام لجنة تحكيم يوم الأحد.

about.en:
Startup Weekend is a 54-hour event run by local organisers with Techstars. On Friday evening participants pitch ideas in 60 seconds; the group votes and teams form around the best ones. Over the weekend teams validate the problem with real customers, build a prototype or landing page and prepare a business model, with coaching from local mentors. On Sunday they demo to a panel of judges, often investors and founders.

More than 7,000 events have been held in 150+ countries with 428,000+ participants. There are general events and themed editions (education, health, women, AI, youth). You don't need an idea or technical skills to join: developers, designers and business people are all needed.

It is one of the best ways for a student to experience building a startup, meet co-founders and connect with the local ecosystem. You can also organise an event in your own city.

en: 7,000+ events in 150+ countries
No idea or experience required
Meet co-founders and mentors in one weekend

eligibility.en: Open to anyone; most events welcome students (some set a minimum age, often 16 or 18). Language depends on the local event.

en: Go to the Startup Weekend page on techstars.com and click 'Find an Event'
Choose an event in your city or online and buy/register a ticket
Prepare a 60-second pitch if you have an idea (optional)
Attend all three days and demo on Sunday

costs.en: Tickets are set by local organisers, usually low cost and often discounted for students; meals during the weekend are usually included.

score_reason: Accessible everywhere, great first startup experience

about.en:
Web Summit Lisbon brings together tens of thousands of attendees, thousands of startups, investors and media each November (the 2026 edition is on 9–12 November 2026). Its startup programme selects early-stage companies to exhibit for a day, take part in the PITCH competition, join investor meetings and office hours, and use the event app to book meetings with investors who have included Neil Shen, Fred Wilson, Reid Hoffman and Vinod Khosla.

The 2026 startup programme is sold out, and applications are now open for 2027 (exact 2027 dates are announced by Web Summit; it is traditionally held in November). The process: apply with a business email, a specialist team assesses and selects startups, and accepted companies prepare with Web Summit's startup success resources before the event.

It suits student founders who already have a product and want maximum exposure; there are package fees, so ask about discounts for very early startups.

en: Exhibit and pitch at one of the world's largest tech conferences
Investor meetings and office hours
Applications open now for 2027

eligibility.en: Early-stage startups from any country (selection by Web Summit's team). Students can also attend Web Summit with student tickets.

en: Go to websummit.com/startups and click 'Apply for 2027'
Enter your business email and startup details
Discuss packages with the specialist team if selected
Prepare your stand, pitch and investor meetings

costs.en: Startup packages are paid (price depends on the programme); travel and accommodation in Lisbon at your own cost.

score_reason: Huge exposure but paid; 2027 dates not yet published

grades: Scouts (youth participants typically mid-teens; adults as IST)
deadline_note: participation only through your national Scout organisation's contingent; each sets its own registration deadline

summary.en: The world's largest youth camp: about 50,000 Scouts and volunteers from more than 170 countries meet in Gdańsk, Poland, from 30 July to 8 August 2027. Young people join through their national Scout association's contingent.
summary.ka: მსოფლიოში ყველაზე დიდი ახალგაზრდული ბანაკი: 170-ზე მეტი ქვეყნის დაახლოებით 50 000 სკაუტი და მოხალისე პოლონეთის ქალაქ გდანსკში 2027 წლის 30 ივლისიდან 8 აგვისტომდე შეიკრიბება. ახალგაზრდები ეროვნული სკაუტური ორგანიზაციის დელეგაციის შემადგენლობაში მონაწილეობენ.
summary.ar: أكبر مخيم شبابي في العالم: نحو 50,000 كشاف ومتطوع من أكثر من 170 دولة يجتمعون في غدانسك ببولندا من 30 يوليو إلى 8 أغسطس 2027. يشارك الشباب ضمن وفد جمعيتهم الكشفية الوطنية.

about.en:
The World Scout Jamboree takes place every four years and is the biggest educational event for young people anywhere. The 26th edition, themed 'Bravely', will be hosted by Poland in Gdańsk from 30 July to 8 August 2027, the first in Europe since Sweden 2011, and will mark 120 years of Scouting on 1 August 2027.

For ten days patrols of Scouts from 170+ countries live together on a giant campsite, cook for each other, take part in adventure, water, cultural, global-development and sustainability programmes, and visit Gdańsk and the Pomorskie region. Adults aged 18+ can serve on the International Service Team (IST) that runs the camp.

You cannot register individually: participants go as part of their country's official contingent, organised by the national Scout association that is a member of WOSM. Contingents set their own age bands (within WOSM rules), fees, selection and deadlines, and many are recruiting now. A Solidarity Operation fund helps Scouts from lower-income countries attend.

en: 50,000 participants from 170+ countries
Ten days of camp, adventure and culture in Gdańsk
Solidarity fund for Scouts from lower-income countries

eligibility.en: Members of a national Scout organisation recognised by WOSM, within the youth-participant age band set for the Jamboree (check with your contingent); adults 18+ can apply as International Service Team members or contingent leaders.

en: Join or contact your national Scout association
Ask about the Jamboree 2027 contingent: age band, fee and deadline
Register through your contingent (individual registration is not possible)
Adults: apply for the International Service Team via your contingent

costs.en: Participant fees are set per country (WOSM fee scale plus travel); the Solidarity Operation helps fund Scouts from lower-income countries.

score_reason: Unique global camp, but only via national Scout contingents

summary.en: Around 350 scholarships each year for students and young professionals from all countries to attend the whole European Forum Alpbach in the Austrian Alps, with seminars, a high-level conference and a lifelong alumni network. Applications open in March 2027.
summary.ka: ყოველწლიურად დაახლოებით 350 სტიპენდია ყველა ქვეყნის სტუდენტებისა და ახალგაზრდა პროფესიონალებისთვის, რათა სრულად დაესწრონ ევროპულ ფორუმ ალპბახს ავსტრიის ალპებში: სემინარები, მაღალი დონის კონფერენცია და მთელი ცხოვრების კურსდამთავრებულთა ქსელი. განაცხადების მიღება 2027 წლის მარტში იწყება.
summary.ar: نحو 350 منحة سنويًا للطلاب والمهنيين الشباب من جميع الدول لحضور منتدى ألباخ الأوروبي كاملًا في جبال الألب النمساوية، مع ندوات ومؤتمر رفيع المستوى وشبكة خريجين مدى الحياة. يُفتح التقديم في مارس 2027.

about.en:
The European Forum Alpbach (EFA) is one of Europe's most important forums on politics, economics, science and culture, held each summer in the Tyrolean village of Alpbach. EFA27 runs from 23 August to 3 September 2027, with the Conference Days opening on 29 August. Scholarship holders are the only participants who stay for the entire forum: they attend scientific, competence-based and artistic seminars and studios, take part in the high-level conference with European leaders, and join a social and cultural programme.

About 350 scholarships are awarded each year to first-time participants from all countries and disciplines; artists and non-graduates are welcome. The scholarship covers the participation fee and accommodation; extra support for food and travel can be requested if needed (subject to funds). Alumni join the Forum Alpbach Network of 34 initiatives in 20 countries.

Applications for 2027 open in March 2027 on alpbach.org. Many students from Georgia, the Western Balkans and the wider world have attended through this programme.

en: ~350 scholarships covering participation fee and accommodation
Open to all countries and disciplines; non-graduates and artists welcome
Seminars plus a high-level European conference in the Alps

eligibility.en: Aged 18–30 at the time of the Forum (18–35 for citizens of the Global South); first-time scholarship holders; English at B2 or above (proof required); able to attend the full duration (departures only from 31 August in justified cases).

en: Read the Scholarship Programme page on alpbach.org
Prepare your latest academic record and proof of English (B2+)
Apply online when applications open in March 2027
Request additional support for travel/food in the application if needed

costs.en: Scholarship covers the participation fee and accommodation. Food and travel are your own unless additional support is granted. Applicants who can afford it are asked to pay their own accommodation (EFA26: €49/night).

score_reason: Funded, open to all nationalities; opens March 2027

summary.en: Y Combinator's free online course on how to start a startup, taught by YC partners and famous founders, with a weekly progress tracker and the world's largest co-founder matching platform. Anyone can sign up at any time.
summary.ka: Y Combinator-ის უფასო ონლაინ კურსი სტარტაპის დაწყების შესახებ, რომელსაც YC-ის პარტნიორები და ცნობილი დამფუძნებლები ასწავლიან; მოიცავს ყოველკვირეული პროგრესის ტრეკერს და მსოფლიოში ყველაზე დიდ თანადამფუძნებლის მოძიების პლატფორმას. რეგისტრაცია ნებისმიერ დროს შეიძლება.
summary.ar: دورة مجانية عبر الإنترنت من Y Combinator حول تأسيس الشركات الناشئة، يقدّمها شركاء YC ومؤسسون مشهورون، مع أداة لمتابعة التقدم الأسبوعي وأكبر منصة في العالم لإيجاد شريك مؤسس. يمكن لأي شخص التسجيل في أي وقت.

about.en:
Startup School distils about 15 years of Y Combinator's knowledge into a free, self-paced online curriculum. Lessons cover planning an MVP, modern startup funding (from the inventor of the SAFE), launching in the press, getting users and growing, leading teams and how and when to apply to YC, plus founder stories from Facebook, 23andMe, Boom and others. It takes roughly seven weeks at one to two hours a week.

Members also get a weekly update tool to stay accountable and access to YC Co-Founder Matching, the world's largest co-founder matching platform with more than 100,000 matches: you create a profile, see recommended candidates by skills, interests and location, and invite people to explore working together.

It is the best free starting point for any student curious about founding a company, and good preparation before applying to YC, Z Fellows or other accelerators.

en: Free YC curriculum taught by YC partners and top founders
Co-founder matching with 100,000+ matches made
Self-paced, about seven weeks, open worldwide

eligibility.en: Anyone at the early stages of building a startup or curious about becoming a founder, from any country. English (videos often have subtitles).

en: Go to startupschool.org and click 'Sign up'
Work through the curriculum at your own pace
Use the weekly update tool to track progress
Create a Co-Founder Matching profile if you need a partner

costs.en: Free.

score_reason: Free, rolling, world-class content for any beginner

summary.ka: უფასო გლობალური სტარტაპ-კონკურსი, დაახლოებით 1 მილიონი დოლარის საპრიზო ფონდით (წილის გარეშე) იდეის, ადრეული, ზრდის და AI მიმართულებებში; საუკეთესო 100 სტარტაპი 2027 წლის ნოემბერში ერ-რიადში გლობალურ ფინალში იასპარეზებს. განაცხადები 2027 წლის 31 მაისამდე მიიღება.
summary.ar: مسابقة عالمية مجانية للشركات الناشئة بجوائز نقدية تقارب مليون دولار دون أخذ حصص، في مسارات الفكرة والمرحلة المبكرة والنمو والذكاء الاصطناعي؛ وتتنافس أفضل 100 شركة في النهائيات العالمية بالرياض في نوفمبر 2027. يُغلق التقديم في 31 مايو 2027.

about.en:
The Entrepreneurship World Cup (EWC), organised by the Global Entrepreneurship Network and hosted by Saudi Arabia, is one of the world's largest startup competitions (2025 drew more than 11,000 startups). It is open to startups at every stage: Idea (concept or prototype), Early (product in market, early revenue) and Growth (scaling), plus Artificial Intelligence sub-tracks.

Timeline on the official site: applications open now and close 31 May 2027; top startups announced in July 2027; the top 250 join a virtual bootcamp with mentoring, pitch training and investor prep in August; the EWC 100 are announced in September and compete live at the Global Finals in Riyadh in November 2027. Prizes are 100% equity-free; the 2026 pool included $200,000 for the early-stage grand prize, $160,000 for growth, $30,000 for idea stage and $50,000 for each AI sub-track. Finalists also get investor access and soft-landing support in Saudi Arabia and the MENA region.

Because the idea track accepts concepts and prototypes, it is realistic for student founders.

en: ~$1M equity-free cash prizes across 12 winners
Idea-stage track open to student concepts
Top 250 get a virtual bootcamp; top 100 go to Riyadh

eligibility.en: Startups and entrepreneurs from any country at idea, early or growth stage; see the official rules for age and company requirements. English.

en: Read the rules on entrepreneurshipworldcup.com
Choose your track: Idea, Early, Growth or AI
Submit the free online application by 31 May 2027
If selected (July 2027), join the August virtual bootcamp
EWC 100 finalists travel to Riyadh in November 2027

costs.en: Free to apply. Check the rules for finalists' travel support to Riyadh.

score_reason: Free, global, big equity-free prizes, idea stage welcome
